name: Enkou Shoujo 2 ~JK Idol Marin no Baai~
original_name: 円交少女２～ＪＫアイドル真鈴の場合～
source:
In the high school idols' life, the moment you turn 18 you become a grandma (BBA), and at the age of 20, you'll become industrial waste.
And today, I turned 18.
The time which I can never regain is now over.

--I don't want to become industrial waste.
I want to run away from this trash industry as soon as possible.

But how will I do that?
